en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not frequent from drinking the water for it extends every illness’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr from certain persons of our people who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not drink water excessively, it is the substance of every illness.’”
